data: Microsoft delivered a strong fiscal 2025, with revenue rising 14.9% to $281.7 billion from $245.1 billion in fiscal 2024. Net income grew 15.5% to $101.8 billion in fiscal 2025 from $88.1 billion a year earlier, so earnings expanded slightly faster than the top line. Cash generation remained a core strength, with operating cash flow climbing to $136.2 billion in fiscal 2025 from $118.5 billion in fiscal 2024. The balance sheet expanded meaningfully. Total assets reached $619.0 billion in fiscal 2025 compared with $512.2 billion in fiscal 2024, while total liabilities rose more modestly to $275.5 billion from $243.7 billion. Cash and cash equivalents also increased to $30.2 billion in fiscal 2025 from $18.3 billion in fiscal 2024. Overall, the fiscal 2025 results point to durable growth backed by robust internal funding capacity.
